source.prompt: Seamless tileable GAME FABRIC COLOR SWATCH, flat and evenly colored, for a fictional early-2000s basketball uniform. Very restrained muted purple appears only as a few broad, soft, irregular low-contrast accent patches distributed across the field and continuing naturally through opposite tile edges. Surface should read as fabric through gentle mottling, with virtually no individual mesh holes or threads visible at normal viewing size. Calm and clean at 32-pixel and 64-pixel display sizes. No vertical or horizontal stripes, no central band, no pinstripes, no repetitive dot grid, no high-frequency weave, no checkerboard, no gradient lighting, no shadow. No garment silhouette, folds, collar, sleeves, seams, stitching, badges, logos, words, names, numbers, real teams, leagues, sponsors, or manufacturers. No object, perspective, photographic reflection, border, or transparency. Opaque sRGB albedo under uniform ambient illumination; seamless in both axes.

No seat shapes, numbers, venue marks, logos, words, symbols, objects, perspective, directional shadows, folds, cast shadows, strong gradients, bright specular streaks, or photographic glare.
